title: Big Chompy Bird Hunting
start: Talk to Rantz, in eastern Feldip Hills.

items.t: Feathers (100+ to be safe, 25 can be bought during quest for 50 coins)
4-6 wolf bones (can be obtained during the quest)
4-6 achey tree logs (can be obtained during the quest)

recommended.t: Dramen staff or A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift completed (fairy ring AKS – fastest way to start)
Armour and weapons (recommended if you're a low level as there are level 11 Wolves to be encountered)
Ranged armour otherwise accuracy of shot damage will be considerably reduced

rewards.t: Ability to hunt chompy birds and cook raw chompy

steps.t: Talk to Rantz east of Feldip Hills. [Chat: 3 How do I make the 'stabbers'?. › Accept]
Chop down two Achey Trees.
Craft ogre arrow shafts from the logs.
Use feathers on the ogre arrow shafts.
Obtain some wolf bones. There are some wolves just south-west of Rantz, by the swamp.
Craft wolf bone arrowheads from the wolf bones.

sub.t: Be careful not to bury the bones.

steps.t: Use the wolf bone arrowheads on the shafts.
Use 6 ogre arrows on Rantz.

Ask Rantz all possible questions. [Chat: 1 How do we make the chompys come? › 2 What are 'fatsy toadies'? › 3 Where do we put the fatsy toadies? › 4 What do you mean 'sneaky..sneaky, stick da chompy?' › 5 Ok, thanks.]
Enter the cave north of Rantz.
Unlock the Locked Ogre chest in the north-west corner, then search it to receive ogre bellows.
Exit the cave and run a short distance south-west to the swamp.
At the swamp, fill bellows via the swamp bubbles, then bloat 3 nearby swamp toads for 3 bloated toads.
Remove any Armour/Augmented Armour this will stop you from killing Chompy
Talk to Rantz.
Drop a bloated toad where the arrow points and wait for a chompy to appear.

sub.t: You may need to drop more toads if the bird doesn't spawn.

steps.t: Talk to Rantz after the chompy appears.
Wait until Rantz has fired his bow and missed the bird, then talk to him.
Convince him to let you try shooting the bird instead. He'll give you an ogre bow. [Chat: 2 Come on, let me have a go... › 1 I'm actually quite strong...please let me try.]
Place another toad in the clearing.

sub.t: Alternatively, you can kill the same chompy bird, if it has not left.

steps.t: Kill the chompy bird that appears with the ogre bow.
Pluck the carcass and take the raw chompy.
Talk to Rantz. Take note of the specific ingredient he wants on the chompy
Go back into the cave and talk to Fycie and Bugs. Take note of the specific ingredients they want on the chompy, all are possible but not necessarily needed.
Obtain the ingredients that they ask for and use the raw chompy on the spit-roast north of Rantz.

sub.t: In case you forgot the ingredients, using the raw chompy on the spit-roast will list them out.

steps.t: Talk to Rantz.
Quest complete!
